children.text: Day 2: Arrival at Marrakech Airport - Overnight in Marrakech:

We will personally welcome you at the Marrakech Airport terminal and provide a comfortable transfer to your Riad, nestled in the heart of the Medina. You'll then have the evening free to explore the vibrant Jamaa El Fna Square at your leisure.
Overnight in Marrakech at - Riad Touda or Riad Nessma & Spa BB
Day 2: Marrakech Sightseeing with a Local Guide:

Your Marrakech adventure begins with a local guide who will meet you at your Riad. Your walking tour will kick off from the renowned Djemaa El-Fna square, a Unesco-declared site that embodies the true essence of Moroccan culture, complete with street theatre, acrobats, snake-charmers, musical performers, and Henna tattoo artists.
Your guide will then take you to some of Marrakech's most iconic sights, starting with the Kotoubia Mosque, a 12th-century marvel, followed by the Ali Ben Youssef Madrassa, a former Qur'anic school that dates back over six centuries. You will then visit the magnificent Bahia Palace, renowned for its intricate Moroccan decoration, and the ruined but beautiful Badi Palace from the 16th century.
The tour continues with a visit to the historic Saadian Tombs, a 16th-century royal necropolis, and Marrakech's vibrant Souks, the city's most colorful markets.
Next, you will move to the modern part of Marrakech, where you will admire the famous Majorelle Gardens and Yves Saint Laurent Museum.
Your guide will escort you back to your Riad in the Medina after the tour.
Overnight in Marrakech at - Riad Touda or Riad Nessma & Spa BB
Day 3: Marrakech to Dades Gorges Via Kasbah Ait Benhaddou:

We will pick you up from your Riad or Hotel in Marrakech and embark on a journey to the High Atlas Mountains, North Africa's highest mountain range, passing through beautiful fertile valleys along the way. We will cross the Tizi N'Tichka Pass, at an elevation of 2260 meters, and drive through dramatic Berber villages and the Ounila Valley to reach the famous Kasbah of Ait-Benhaddou. This fortified village dates back to the 12th century and its buildings were recognized by UNESCO in 1987.

The Kasbah is also famous for being a backdrop for many international movies and series, such as Gladiator and Game of Thrones. We will escort you to the Kasbah and take you on a tour to explore this authentic and traditional site. You will walk through its small mud-brick alleys to reach the granaries, the most fortified spot in the Kasbah. After a lunch break at a local restaurant near the Kasbah, we will continue our journey to Ouarzazate, known as the Cinema Capital of Morocco, with its movie studios and sets.

In the center of the city, we will visit the ancient Kasbah of Tourirt, a charming pit stop before we continue on to the Valley of Roses through the "Road of Thousand Kasbahs." We will then drive through the Valley of Roses to reach the Dades Valley, a region of stunning landscapes filled with fields of wheat, walnuts, and figs. At the end of the day, we will drop you off at your Riad in the Dades Valley.
Overnight in Dades Gorges at Dar Blues or Dades Paradise HB
Day 4: Dades Gorges - Todra Gorges - Arfoud - Merzouga Desert:

We'll meet once again at your Riad or hotel in the Dades Valley, and start our journey through the breathtaking landscapes. Our first stop will be the town of Tinerhir, which was once a bustling transit hub for miners and a key trading center for caravans. A short drive from the town, you'll come across a palm oasis and the abandoned 19th-century village.

Next, we'll head to Todgha Gorges, where 300m-high orange canyons, filled with a crystal-clear river, run through the limestone cliffs. Our journey to the desert continues, taking us through the Anti-Atlas Mountains, dotted with Berber towns, villages, and oases. During the drive, you'll encounter nomads tending to their sheep, goats, and camels.

We'll then arrive in the small city of Erfoud, a fossil town and one of Morocco's largest exporters of dates. A 40-minute drive from Erfoud will take us to the Merzouga Desert, also known as one of the last paradises on Earth. We'll arrive at a hotel in the dune line just before sunset, giving you time to relax and make use of the facilities before joining your camels. Our camel guide will escort you through the Erg Chebbi dunes, making a memorable stop at the highest dune to enjoy the spectacular sunset. After the sunset, you'll continue your camel trek to the desert camp where you'll be greeted with traditional Berber music performed live around the campfire
Overnight in Merzouga Desert at Tiziri Camp or Ideal Desert Camp HB
Day 5: Merzouga Desert Excursion & Optional Activities:

Join us on a mesmerizing journey through Morocco's Erg Chebbi sand dunes and the Merzouga Desert, one of Morocco's most stunning attractions. We'll pick you up from your desert camp and set out to explore.

Our first stop is at a Nomad's tent, where you'll enjoy a traditional cup of tea and learn about their rich culture and way of life. Then, visit one of the oldest coal mines in Mfis village, a remnant from the French occupation. Next, discover the Khamlia village, home to descendants of escaped slaves and famous for their traditional Gnaoua music. Enjoy a live show before a delicious lunch at a local Berber Pizza restaurant.

After lunch, continue your desert excursion to one of the most incredible sights, a seasonal lake in the middle of the desert, a haven for desert birds like desert warblers and flamingos. At the end of the day, relax at your hotel in the dune lines and enjoy the breathtaking dune views from your terrace.

For those seeking additional adventure, there are plenty of optional desert sports and activities to choose from. So, rest and rejuvenate, and we'll be ready to take you on another exciting adventure tomorrow!
Overnight in Merzouga Desert at Tiziri Camp or Ideal Desert Camp HB
Day 6: Merzouga Desert - Deraa Valley - Ouarzazate:

After a hearty breakfast at the camp, you will be picked up by a 4x4 car for a journey across the striking Erg Chebbi dunes to a hotel located within the dune lines. Your driver will be waiting for you there.
Leaving the Merzouga desert, you will head to the bustling Rissani Local Market, where you can take a leisurely walk and discover the Berber culture, as well as the trading traditions of the region.
Your next stop is N’Kob, a small village boasting 44 authentic Kasbahs and a picturesque palm grove oasis, reached by driving through the Hamada mountains and the palm tree-filled Deraa Valley.
After a delicious lunch in Agdez, you will cross the Ait Saouen mountain pass to reach Ouarzazate, famously known as the "Hollywood of Morocco" due to its use as a backdrop for numerous international movies and series.
Before departing to your accommodation, you will tour the city's cinema studios, museum, and the Taourirt Kasbah, located in the heart of the city.
Overnight in Ouarzazate at Dar Chamaa or Kassbah Yu Palace HB
Day 7: Ouarzazate - High Atlas Mountains - Marrakech:

We will conitinue our journey from Ouarzazate to the majestic High Atlas Mountains, passing through the lush Ounila Valley and its stunning river landscapes and Berber villages. Our first stop is at the historic Telouat Kasbah, a magnificent 18th-century fortress, where you'll admire its traditional Moroccan design.

Crossing the High Atlas Mountains, we'll take in the breathtaking scenery of the Tizi N’tichka pass, which stands at 2260m. After reaching Marrakech, we'll drop you off at your accommodation located in the heart of the city's ancient medina. Get ready to be transported to the vibrant and rich cultural heritage of Marrakech.
Overnight in Marrakech at - Riad Touda or Riad Nessma & Spa BB
